title: Automated background token refresh mechanism
summary: Improves session resilience by transparently refreshing authentication tokens before expiration.
problem_before: Users experienced unexpected session timeouts when API tokens expired mid-workflow.
solution: Introduced an automatic background refresh worker with exponential backoff on retry.
reason: Eliminate user disruptions and improve overall session reliability.
user_impact: Users remain authenticated continuously during active sessions without manual re-login.
tech_impact: Adds periodic timer thread and refresh lock to prevent concurrent token race conditions.
risks: Network partitioning during refresh could require fallback to manual login prompt
migration_notes: Backward compatible. No client-side configuration changes required.
next_steps: Monitor telemetry for token refresh latency across distributed regions
